Every matroid of rank or corank at most three is $Z$ -Rayleigh.
Moreover, if $M$ is simple of rank three, then, for all distinct
 $e,f\in E(M)$ , all $0<q\leq 1$ and all $x>0$ ,

 $q^{6}(\Delta_{e,f}Z_{M})(q,x)\geq(1-q)^{2}(\Delta_{e,f}S_{M})(x)\geq(1-q)^{2}(\Delta_{e,f}B_{M})(x)\geq 0.$

open BigOperators

lemma x2611_15512_thm1_3_aux1 {α : Type*} (P : MvPolynomial α ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ d, 0 ≤ P.coeff d) (x : α → ℝ) (hx : ∀ a, 0 ≤ x a) :
    0 ≤ MvPolynomial.eval x P := by
  rw [MvPolynomial.eval_eq]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun d hd =>
    mul_nonneg (hP d) (Finset.prod_nonneg fun a ha => pow_nonneg (hx a) _)

lemma x2611_15512_thm1_3_aux2 {α : Type*} (P : MvPolynomial α (Polynomial ℝ))
    (hP : ∀ d k, 0 ≤ (P.coeff d).coeff k)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (x : α → ℝ) (hx : ∀ a, 0 ≤ x a) :
    0 ≤ MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Polynomial.evalRingHom q) x P := by
  rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂_eq]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro d hd
  apply mul_nonneg
  · change 0 ≤ Polynomial.eval q (P.coeff d)
    rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum, Polynomial.sum_def]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun k hk => mul_nonneg (hP d k) (pow_nonneg hq _)
  · exact Finset.prod_nonneg fun a ha => pow_nonneg (hx a) _

lemma x2611_15512_thm1_3_aux3 {α R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    (P : MvPolynomial α R) (e : α) :
    (MvPolynomial.pderiv e P).vars ⊆ P.vars := by
  classical
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨d, hd, had⟩ := (MvPolynomial.mem_vars_iff_mem_support a).mp ha
  have hc : P.coeff (d + Finsupp.single e 1) ≠ 0 := by
    have h := MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hd
    rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_pderiv] at h
    intro hc
    exact h (by rw [hc, zero_mul])
  apply (MvPolynomial.mem_vars_iff_mem_support a).mpr
  refine ⟨d + Finsupp.single e 1, MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mpr hc, ?_⟩
  have hda : d a ≠ 0 := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp had
  simp only [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, Finsupp.add_apply]
  omega

lemma x2611_15512_thm1_3_aux4 {α R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (P : MvPolynomial α R) (e f : α) :
    (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference P e f).vars ⊆ P.vars := by
  classical
  intro a ha
  have hsub := MvPolynomial.vars_sub_subset
    (p := MvPolynomial.pderiv e P * MvPolynomial.pderiv f P)
    (q := P * MvPolynomial.pderiv e (MvPolynomial.pderiv f P)) ha
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hsub with h | h
  · rcases Finset.mem_union.mp (MvPolynomial.vars_mul _ _ h) with h | h
    · exact x2611_15512_thm1_3_aux3 P e h
    · exact x2611_15512_thm1_3_aux3 P f h
  · rcases Finset.mem_union.mp (MvPolynomial.vars_mul _ _ h) with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact x2611_15512_thm1_3_aux3 P f
        (x2611_15512_thm1_3_aux3 (MvPolynomial.pderiv f P) e h)

lemma x2611_15512_thm1_3_aux5 {α R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R]
    (A : Finset α) :

  classical
  intro a ha
  have h := MvPolynomial.vars_prod (fun b : α => (MvPolynomial.X b : MvPolynomial α R)) ha
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hab⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp h
  have hab' : a = b := by simpa only [MvPolynomial.vars_X, Finset.mem_singleton] using hab
  simpa only [hab'] using hb

    (P : Set α → Prop) (E : Set α) (hP : ∀ A, P A → A ⊆ E) :
    ∀ a ∈ (x2611_15512_set_polynomial P).vars, a ∈ E := by
  classical

  unfold x2611_15512_set_polynomial at ha
  have h := MvPolynomial.vars_sum_subset _ _ ha
  obtain ⟨A, hA, ha⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp h
  exact hP (↑A) (Finset.mem_filter.mp hA).2
    (x2611_15512_thm1_3_aux5 A ha)

    (M : Matroid α) (q : ℝ) :

    have hh := MvPolynomial.vars_mul _ _ ha
    simpa using hh
  exact Set.mem_toFinset.mp ((Finset.mem_powerset.mp hA)
    (x2611_15512_thm1_3_aux5 A ha'))

    (P : MvPolynomial α R) (x y : α → R)

    (E : Finset α) (l : α → L) (r : α → R)

    apply mul_nonneg (hx z ((Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp hA).1 hz))
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun B hB => sq_nonneg _
  · simp

lemma x2611_15512_thm1_3_aux12 {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (M : Matroid α) (hr : M.eRank ≤ 3) (q : ℝ) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    MvPolynomial.map (Polynomial.evalRingHom q) (x2611_15512_normalized_tutte M) =

    Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X]

    (e f : α) (he : e ∈ M.E) (hf : f ∈ M.E) (hef : e ≠ f)

      q ^ 6 * MvPolynomial.eval x (x2611_15512_rayleigh_difference
        (x2611_15512_tutte M q) e f)) ∧
